record_scope_reconstruction: Planned technical maintenance suspension of the La Gabrielle international vehicle/passenger ferry between Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni, French Guiana, and Albina, Suriname, September25–October30,2017 inclusive. Ordered window is retained without inferring actual restart. Only this ferry link, represented by its two historical landing points, is mapped; other river craft are outside scope.
